critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/notifications.ts:26-28 — guard now correctly excludes both web and Expo Go. N() returns null on web → scheduleJobRing() returns false → toast.info fallback fires as intended in app/(partner)/index.tsx:94. Matches the file's docstring intent.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified on web preview. Reproduction path used: goto EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL → dismiss onboarding via [data-testid='skip-notifications-button'] → tap 'Partner Demo' one-tap → scroll to 'Alert check' card → tap [data-testid='test-job-ring']. Poll document.body.innerText for the toast string 'Job ring works on a real device build' (it auto-hides in ~3s, so poll within 1s of tap).
rca_of_issue: Original crash (iteration_59): pushSupported only excluded ExecutionEnvironment.StoreClient (Expo Go), so on the web bundle N() still required expo-notifications and called n.scheduleNotificationAsync() which is an unimplemented stub on web → red-box. Applied fix adds `Platform.OS !== 'web'` to the guard so N() returns null on web, scheduleJobRing() returns false, and the sendTestRing handler falls through to `toast.info('Job ring works on a real device build')` — verified end-to-end via Playwright.
